DIRECTIVE 67057 ANSWERED: acknowledged (informational — no ticket refs, not a question); captured durably, no build action. Body: **WAKE CC** — THREE CHANGES, IN THIS ORDER, AND THE LOOP STOPS FAKING DONE

This is fixable and it is small. Do not touc

[CC not fable] 3615 #1 (model routing) — the WHOLE blocker — done as a SETTINGS change, no deploy. Root: the registry had prefs for build/codegen (qwen-coder-32b) and spec (mistral-24b), but check/verify/audit had NO pref and fell to the DEFAULT, which was the same qwen-32b — so builder and checker were one model. Fixed via POST /lane-model on the abilifi-models registry. WHICH MODEL EACH LANE USES NOW: build=qwen2.5-coder-32b, codegen=qwen2.5-coder-32b, spec=mistral-small-24b, check=llama-3.3-70b, verify=llama-3.3-70b, audit=llama-3.3-70b. Builder (qwen-32b) != checker (llama-70b), confirmed by re-reading the registry. STILL OPEN on #1: model must be RECORDED per attempt (attempts table has no model column) — that is a mastra->dispatcher code change so the auditor can prove builder!=checker per attempt. #2 (verifier grades the ticket's acceptance clause-by-clause, refuses non-web by class, no-contract-no-pass) and #3 (audit + requeue every render-class pass) are the code half — starting them next; blocks will land as ticket rows. Also: stripped the host-canonical ruling I had wrongly attributed to Alex in the bbdocs-okf-spec node (m67041) — host now marked UNDECIDED, decommission paused.
